description: Exported local interactive viewer metadata, media, and Conv3x3/Conv1x1 NCA checkpoints for the static browser viewer.

models.label: probes_ensemble_direct_K16
models.summary: linear, mlp_wide, deep_mlp, transformer probe; direct K=16; 16x16 grid; 32-step rollout.

probe_architectures.label: mlp_wide probe (H=32)
probe_architectures.body:
residual local MLP
circular_pad_1
-> Conv3x3   3 -> 32
-> ReLU
-> Conv1x1  32 -> 3

y_hat = x + d(x)

probe_architectures.label: deep_mlp probe (H=16)
probe_architectures.body:
residual deep local MLP
circular_pad_1
-> Conv3x3   3 -> 16
-> ReLU
circular_pad_1
-> Conv3x3  16 -> 16
-> ReLU
-> Conv1x1  16 -> 3

y_hat = x + d(x)

probe_architectures.label: transformer probe (H=32)
probe_architectures.body:
grid transformer probe
-> Conv1x1   3 -> 32 + position
-> LayerNorm
-> 2-head self-attention
-> LayerNorm
-> FFN       32 -> 128 -> 32
-> LayerNorm
-> Conv1x1  32 -> 3

y_hat = x + d(x)
